name: plite-libraries-plite-react-external-text-docs
title: External Text Views
description: Render one canonical Plite Text through an adapter-owned editing surface.

files.content:
--- title: "External Text Views" description: "Render one canonical Plite Text through an adapter-owned editing surface." --- Use `slots.externalText` when another text engine should own a block's DOM and local input. Plite keeps the document, selection, history, and remote changes; the adapter is a view, not another editor document. ## Example The [External Text example](/examples/plite/external-text) renders the same document through native Plite and an app-local textarea adapter. It includes shared undo, a second external view, named roots, read-only state, and decoration delivery. The textarea demonstrates the protocol; it is not a large-code editor and cannot paint individual decoration ranges inside its input. ## Supported model The block's compiled schema must permit exactly one direct Text: ```ts import { defineEditorSchema, schema } from "plitejs"; const sourceSchema = defineEditorSchema("schema:source", { elements: { source: { content: schema.content.text({ min: 1, max: 1 }) }, }, root: schema.content.type("source"), }); ``` The live block must also contain one Text and must not be inline, void, or atomic. Newlines stay in that Text. Whole-Text properties survive offset edits; rich children and partial marks use native Plite rendering instead. The slot rejects unsupported content before mounting an adapter. ## Render slot Pass an app-owned `ExternalTextAdapter` from `plitejs/react`. Keep its identity stable across renders. ```tsx element.type === "source" ? ( 
        {slots.externalText({ adapter, ariaLabel: "Source text" })}
) : (

{slots.children()}

) } /> ``` Choose exactly one projection per element. In the external branch, do not read `children` or call `slots.children()`. Plite mounts a labelled, noneditable host with no hidden duplicate of the canonical text. `ariaLabel` is required and nonempty. The adapter labels its actual input from the host. An adapter's `TConfig` determines the `config` option's type; config updates reach the mounted view without recreating it. ## Adapter lifecycle `ExternalTextAdapter.mount({ actions, host, state })` creates the local DOM and returns an `ExternalTextView`: | Method | Contract | | --- | --- | | `update({ changes, state })` | Apply exact patches and the supplied canonical state without dispatching another edit. | | `focus({ edge?, x? }?)` | Focus the local input and honor the requested boundary or horizontal position where supported. | | `destroy()` | Release every local listener and resource and remove the adapter's DOM. | `state` contains `text`, `version`, `selection`, `readOnly`, `decorations`, and `config`. Retain the canonical text reference; do not diff whole strings to discover outbound Plite edits. Decorations are keyed `{ start, end, attributes }` slices in this Text's offsets. The adapter owns their visual representation. `changes` has three meanings: | Value | Meaning | | --- | --- | | Patch list | Apply sorted, non-overlapping `{ from, to, insert }` replacements in the previous text's UTF-16 coordinates. Apply right to left if mutating a string in place. | | `[]` | Acknowledge a local edit or update selection, configuration, read-only state, or decorations without changing text. | | `null` | Reset to `state.text`, cancel local composition, and discard an unaccepted local prediction. | Structural replacement, stale input, canonical correction, and conflicting remote composition can require resets. Ordinary text edits, history replay, and non-conflicting remote patches do not require a reset. Mounting is client-only. SSR emits the empty host. Unmounting, root changes, and explicit document virtualization destroy the view; remount from canonical state. Adapter failures reach the editor's `lifecycleErrorSink` with `source: "external-text"`. A failed view rejects edits until reset or remount. ## Actions Pass the last delivered `state.version` as `baseVersion`. Plite rejects stale, invalid, and read-only edits without changing the document. | Action | Contract | | --- | --- | | `dispatch({ baseVersion, changes, intent, selection })` | Submit one edit with `input`, `paste`, `cut`, `drop`, or `composition` intent. Selection uses the resulting text's directed UTF-16 offsets. | | `select({ baseVersion, selection })` | Set directed `{ anchor, focus }` offsets without changing text. | | `navigateOut({ baseVersion, direction, extend?, x? })` | Ask Plite to move into neighboring document content, optionally extending selection. | | `deleteOut({ baseVersion, direction })` | Delete across a block edge when the canonical caret is collapsed at that edge. | | `composition("start" \| "end")` | Join and finish Plite's composition epoch. Submit composition edits with `intent: "composition"`. | | `history("undo" \| "redo")` | Use the installed Plite history extension. Returns `false` when no history action applies. | Versioned actions return `{ status: "applied" | "stale" | "read-only" }`. Adapters disable independent undo stacks and never dispatch from `mount`, `update`, `focus`, or `destroy` callbacks. ## Selection and native features Only the focused view receives `selection.mode: "native"` for a selection wholly inside its Text. Other views and cross-boundary selections receive `"model"`; paint that intersection without changing browser selection or focus. Avoid redundant native selection writes during focus transitions. The adapter owns local input, local clipboard formats, accessibility, search, spelling, and printing. Plite copies a cross-boundary selection from the full canonical model, including text absent from native Plite DOM. Rich drag moves between engines are outside this contract; plain-text transfers must not also delete their source. There is no fixed-height requirement. Adapter-internal virtualization and Plite's explicit [document virtualization](experimental-virtualized-rendering) are separate choices. Neither this slot nor the textarea example guarantees browser find, full screen-reader traversal, or print over unmounted text. ## Related - [Editable Component](editable) - [DOM Coverage Boundaries](dom-coverage-boundaries) - [Selection And DOM](../../concepts/16-selection-and-dom) - [History](../plite-history/history)
